segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making the time, Mark. Sorry we had to push from this morning; I was cleaning up the quote rows so billing had the three ship-to sites split correctly. But I’ve got the pricing sheet in front of me now.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No worries. I only have about twenty minutes. We’re still looking at 48 seats to start, with maybe another 12 in September if the warehouse team likes it.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That works. For 48 seats on the annual plan, you’re at $31,680 for the first year. If you add the 12 later, they co-term to the June 30 renewal, so it’s a prorated add-on, not a new contract.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Procurement asked whether the invoice can split 60 percent to operations and 40 percent to finance. Same PO, just two cost centers.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, we can do that. I’ll note it on the order form, and the billing tool can show both cost centers on the invoice. First invoice would go out after signature, net 30.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. On go-live, we have July 15 circled. Is that realistic if we sign by next Friday, June 21?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, assuming we get the user list by June 25. Implementation would do kickoff the week of July 1, configuration that same week, then training on July 10 or 11. July 15 is fine.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: The only contract thing is termination for convenience. Our standard asks for 30 days. Your paper says no termination during the first year.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Right, our standard is no termination for convenience in year one. What I can offer is a 60-day opt-out after the first 90 days if the uptime or support response times miss the SLA twice. I can get that language from legal.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Send that over. If legal doesn’t hate it, I think we’re there.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I’ve got a 2:30 block to get renewal notes copied into the CRM, but I’ll move that and get you the revised terms before 4 today.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Send it to me and copy Jenna in procurement.
